title: Binance Margin Will Update the Collateral Ratio of Multiple Cross Margin Assets (2026-01-12)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin  will update the  collateral ratio  for the following assets under Cross Margin between  2026-01-12 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within  approximately 30 minutes . The following assets will be adjusted on  2026-01-12 06:00 (UTC):   Asset Old Rank New Rank ARB 6 7  ADA 4 5  CFX 8 9  TRX 7 6  ASTER 8 7  XPL 9 8  ZEC 8 7  The collateral ratio for assets no. 8, 9, and 10 are set out below. More collateral ratio information and calculation methods can be found on the  Margin Data  page. Asset No. Tiers (USD) Collateral Ratio 8 0 - 100,000 100.00% 100,000 - 250,000 80.00% 250,000 - 500,000 60.00% 500,000 - 700,000 30.00% 700,000 - 1,000,000 10.00% 1,000,000 - 100,000,000,000 0.00% 9 0 - 100,000 100.00% 100,000 - 150,000 80.00% 150,000 - 200,000 60.00% 200,000 - 400,000 30.00% 400,000 - 600,000 10.00% 600,000 - 100,000,000,000 0.00% 10 0 - 100,000 100.00% 100,000 - 100,000,000,000 0.00% Please Note:  Amendments to the collateral ratio will affect  Margin Level (ML)  in  Cross Margin Pro Mode . Users should monitor ML closely to avoid any potential liquidation or losses that may result from these changes. Binance bears no responsibility in the event that a user fails to adjust their collateral for the purposes of their use of Binance Margin products.
